title.narrative: Making Multi-Sectoral Coordination Work: Collaborating towards better nutrition, food security and development for everyone

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Action is to improve Namibia¿s nutrition situation and food systems

The specific objectives of the action are: CSOs in Namibia are integrated into Namibia¿s revised Food and Nutrition Security Coordination Structures; The involvement of CSOs in the Government¿s nutrition policy and agenda at national level has increased; and, the commitment of Namibian businesses to nutrition-related issues has increased

description.narrative: SDG indicator 2.2.3 Anaemia rates in females are much higher than males. While anaemia rates decrease for males by the end of puberty, they remain high for females through reproductive years due to menstruation. Therefore, reducing anaemia contributes to boosting females relative academic performance and workerproductivity and helps achieve gender equality.
